tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search live, public Givore giveaway listings in one Spanish city, optionally narrowed to one category. Newest first.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one live, public Givore giveaway listing by id. Returns {"status": "unavailable"} once it is claimed, removed or otherwise not public, and for any id that is not a giveaway.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_listing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
